title: Comparison with the competitor Z + π_#X projected into N
statement:
Assume (C1), the frozen statement of the sibling-of-parent node dor_imrep_massOn_eq_measure_and_support: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, open U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and every integer multiplicity triple R in U representing T, M_W(T) = μ_R(W) for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P, and spt T = U ∩ spt μ_R. Let P, d, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, N ⊆ ℝ^P an embedded C² d-dimensional submanifold, and y ∈ N. Let r, c, ρ, t ∈ ℝ with c ≥ 0, ρ > 0, 3ρ < r, 4cρ ≤ 1, t < 2ρ and B̄_{3ρ}(y) ⊆ U.
Let π : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C¹ on B_r(y) with π(B_r(y)) ⊆ N. Assume π(x) = x and Dπ(x)v = v for x ∈ N ∩ B_r(y) and v ∈ T_xN (tangentSpace), and ‖Dπ(x)‖ ≤ 1 + c|x − y| for x ∈ B_r(y).
Let Z ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be minimizing in U ∩ N (7.1.1) with spt Z ⊆ N and ∂Z = 0, represented by an integer multiplicity triple RZ. Let X ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be integer multiplicity with ∂X = 0 and X(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) whose support is disjoint from B̄_t(y). Let Y ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with Y = Z + X, represented by an integer multiplicity triple RY. Then
μ_{RZ}(B̄_t(y)) ≤ (1 + 3cρ)ⁿ μ_{RY}(B̄_t(y)) + ((1 + 3cρ)ⁿ − 1) μ_{RZ}(B_{3ρ}(y)).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support) → ∀ (P d n : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (Z X Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (RZ RY : IMRep U n) (proj : Euclid P → Euclid P) (y : Euclid P) (r c ρ t : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < n → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → IsMinimizingIn Z (U ∩ N) → Z.support ⊆ N → BoundaryVanishes Z → RZ.Represents Z → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → BoundaryVanishes X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (closedBall y t) → X ω = 0) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Y ω = Z ω + X ω) → RY.Represents Y → y ∈ N → 0 ≤ c → 0 < ρ → 3 * ρ < r → 4 * c * ρ ≤ 1 → t < 2 * ρ → closedBall y (3 * ρ) ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 proj (ball y r) → MapsTo proj (ball y r) N → (∀ x ∈ N ∩ ball y r, proj x = x) → (∀ x ∈ N ∩ ball y r, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace N x, fderiv ℝ proj x v = v) → (∀ x ∈ ball y r, ‖fderiv ℝ proj x‖ ≤ 1 + c * dist x y) → RZ.measure (closedBall y t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 3 * c * ρ) ^ n) * RY.measure (closedBall y t) + ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 3 * c * ρ) ^ n - 1) * RZ.measure (ball y (3 * ρ))
